{{Quote|The fortress we're invading is on the planet Taral Five. Enemy territory, protected by Imperial warships. Too many to fight.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Oteg]]|<ref name="TOR:TJP">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|The Jedi Prisoner|the ''Telos''}}</ref>}}
'''Taral V''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] controlled by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. During the Cold War, a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] strike team was [[Battle of Taral V|sent]] to Taral V to retrieve information on a [[Revan/Legends|missing Jedi]]. The planet was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to many dangerous [[Species/Legends|species]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Taral Five has no shortage of hungry predators. Unsurprisingly, the Empire's fond of them.|Oteg|<ref name="TOR:T5" />}}
Taral V had a tropical environment. The [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] landscape was covered in tall [[Grass/Legends|grass]] and [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]]. Taral V also had frequent lightning strikes, which were powerful enough to bring down an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]].<ref name="TOR:T5" />

Taral V was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to many dangerous native [[Species/Legends|species]], including [[Lurker/Legends|lurkers]], [[jurgoran]]s, [[gundark]]s and [[vine cat]]s, all of which were aggressive and dangerous to even a highly armed [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] strike team.<ref name="TOR:T5" />

==History==
{{Quote|The only way to navigate the Maelstrom is using a Gree computer hidden at an Imperial fortress. We need that computer to free the Jedi prisoner.|Oteg|<ref name="TOR:TJP" />}}
A Galactic Republic strike team was [[Battle of Taral V|sent]] to the planet by [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] [[Oteg]] to assault a heavily guarded [[Taral V Imperial fortress|Imperial compound]]. The mission's objective was to gain access to an ancient [[Gree computer|Gree navigation computer]] in order to navigate the [[Maelstrom Nebula/Legends|Maelstrom]] [[Nebula/Legends|Nebula]] and find the [[Maelstrom Prison|prison]] where the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] was held prisoner.<ref name="TOR:TJP" /> During the mission the strike team encountered many of the native animals and Imperials. The team then went on to fight [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Shivanek]] and his pet [[Ripper (pet)|Ripper]], defeating them and then taking down the base's security system. After infiltrating the base, they finally accessed the Gree [[Computer/Legends|computer]]. Imperial [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Rycus Kilran]] later bombarded and destroyed the base in an unsuccessful attempt to prevent the Republic strike team to escape with the Gree technology.<ref name="TOR:T5" />

==Behind the scenes==
Taral V is one of the planets featured in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It is the location for the Flashpoint Taral V.<ref name="TOR:T5" />
